title: 第 712章 金昊的手段第 711章 灭杀红衣男子
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
第712章金昊的手段
金昊原本正和苏清婉、徐景安以及另一名妖修白寒川在山顶商议如何进入火山底部取宝，忽然收到同族金雕的求救。
他匆忙赶来，却还是迟了一步，眼睁睁看着自己的族人被斩杀。
陆行舟直起身，看向来人，脸上并无意外之色，平静地与对方对视。
金昊看清他的面容后先是一愣，随即怒火中烧，眼中满是杀意：“好好好！之前在密林中我放你一马，没想到你不知死活，竟敢跑到这里来，还杀我族人，今日我要将你碎尸万段。”
话音未落，他周身灵力涌动，背后浮现一轮金色虚影，那是一只三足金乌的轮廓，虽不甚清晰，却散发着一股古老而炽烈的恐怖气息。
“金乌血脉！”陆行舟瞳孔骤缩，心中警铃大作。
他清楚哪怕此人只得到小部分传承，也足以让他的战力远超同阶，何况自己与他境界还有很大差距。
金昊抬手虚握，一把通体灿金的长枪飞出，枪身缠绕着炽白的金乌火焰。
他身形一动，速度快得连残影都来不及留下，枪尖已刺至陆行舟面门。
陆行舟连忙催动星盾抵挡，彩色灵光在枪尖下剧烈荡漾，竟被刺得凹陷下去，盾牌瞬间暗淡无光。
他借力向后急退，六把法剑齐出，化作漫天剑影斩向金昊周身要害。
金昊冷哼一声，长枪横扫，金色火焰如巨浪般席卷而出，将剑光尽数吞没。
六把法剑被震得倒飞出去，陆行舟也受冲击波波及，身形踉跄，一缕金乌火焰擦过肩头，护体灵光瞬间被灼穿，皮肉焦黑一片。
金昊得势不饶人，长枪连刺，枪尖化作漫天金色光影，笼罩陆行舟全身。
陆行舟挥着手中斧刃左支右绌，催动剑阵试图困住对方，可对方枪尖一转，金乌火焰横扫而出，竟直接将刚落地的法剑破开。
他法诀变幻，倒飞出去的法剑凝聚成巨剑，猛的朝对方劈去。
金昊见状，朝着长枪加大灵力灌入，金色长枪骤然涨大至百丈，化作金色弧光，迎了上去。
“铛！”
金铁交鸣之声在空中炸响，巨剑寸寸崩碎，散成数把法剑倒飞出去，剑身灵光黯淡了几分。

“自不量力，今日我便让你知道什么是境界差距。”
金昊冷笑一声，长枪骤然化作数条百丈长的金色火龙，怒吼着朝陆行舟扑来，所过之处山石崩裂、地面龟裂，热浪将方圆数里化为一片焦土。
陆行舟知道，常规手段对此人没用，必须动用所有底牌。
他眼神一凝，默念口诀，一道灰光从他眉心射出，直刺金昊识海。
金昊丝毫没有反应，惊魂刺刚触碰到他眉心，他胸前突然爆发出一道白光，将魂刺给拦了下来。
他神色微怔，随即讥讽道：“居然还懂得神魂攻击，可惜对我没用，不然还真着了你的道了。”
陆行舟脸色难看，来不及多想，见袭来的火龙裹挟焚天热浪近在咫尺，他右手凝爪，迎着金色火龙抓去。
“轰隆！”
爪影与火龙轰然相撞，滔天热浪瞬间炸开。
狂暴的灵力冲击将陆行舟整个人掀飞出去，重重砸在岩壁上。
content_en:
Chapter 712 Jin Hao’s methods
Jin Hao was originally discussing with Su Qingwan, Xu Jing'an and another demon cultivator Bai Hanchuan on the top of the mountain how to enter the bottom of the volcano to retrieve the treasure, when he suddenly received a request for help from a fellow golden eagle.
He came in a hurry, but was still a step late, and watched helplessly as his people were killed.
Lu Xingzhou straightened up and looked at the person. There was no surprise on his face, and he looked at the person calmly.
Jin Hao was stunned for a moment after seeing his face clearly, and then he became furious, with murderous intent in his eyes: "Okay, okay! I let you go in the dense forest before, but I didn't expect that you didn't care about life and death, so you dared to come here and kill my people. Today I will cut you into pieces."
Before he finished speaking, spiritual energy surged around his body, and a golden shadow appeared behind him. It was the outline of a three-legged golden crow. Although it was not very clear, it exuded an ancient and blazing terrifying aura.
"Golden Crow bloodline!" Lu Xingzhou's pupils shrank suddenly, alarm bells blaring in his heart.
He knew that even if this person only received a small part of the inheritance, it would be enough to make his combat power far higher than that of the same level, not to mention that there was still a big gap between him and himself.
Jin Hao raised his hand and held it in vain, and a golden spear flew out, with the body of the spear wrapped in blazing golden crow flames.
He moved so fast that he didn't even have time to leave an afterimage, and the tip of his spear had already pierced Lu Xingzhou's face.
Lu Xingzhou quickly mobilized the star shield to resist. The colored spiritual light rippled violently under the tip of the spear. It was actually dented by the spear tip, and the shield instantly dimmed.
He used his strength to retreat sharply, and all six magic swords came out, turning into sword shadows all over the sky and slashing at Jin Hao's vitals.
Jin Hao snorted coldly, swept his spear across, and the golden flames swept out like a huge wave, engulfing all the sword light.
The six magic swords were shaken and flew backwards. Lu Xingzhou was also affected by the shock wave and staggered. A wisp of golden crow flames passed over his shoulders. The protective aura was instantly burned through, and his skin was scorched black.
Jin Hao gained the upper hand and stabbed Lu Xingzhou continuously with his spear. The tip of the spear turned into golden light and shadow that filled the sky, covering Lu Xingzhou's body.
Lu Xingzhou waved the ax blade in his hand, activating the sword formation in an attempt to trap the opponent. However, the opponent's spear point turned, and the golden crow flames swept out, directly breaking the magic sword that had just landed on the ground.
His magic formula changed, and the magic sword that flew out condensed into a giant sword and slashed towards the opponent fiercely.
Seeing this, Jin Hao poured more spiritual power into the spear. The golden spear suddenly grew to a hundred feet, turned into a golden arc, and rushed forward.
"Cang!"
The sound of metal and iron clashing exploded in the air, and the giant sword shattered inch by inch, scattering into several magic swords and flying upside down. The aura of the sword body dimmed a bit.
"I don't know what I can do. Today I will let you know what the realm gap is."
Jin Hao sneered, and the spear suddenly turned into several hundred-foot-long golden fire dragons, roaring towards Lu Xingzhou. The rocks collapsed and the ground cracked wherever they passed, and the heat wave turned miles around into a piece of scorched earth.
Lu Xingzhou knew that conventional methods were useless against this person and he had to use all his trump cards.
His eyes condensed and he recited the mantra silently. A gray light shot out from between his eyebrows and pierced Jin Hao's sea of ​​consciousness.
Jin Hao didn't react at all. As soon as the frightening thorn touched the center of his eyebrows, a white light suddenly burst out from his chest, stopping the soul thorn.
He looked slightly startled, and then sarcastically said: "You actually know how to attack with the soul, but it's a pity that it's useless to me, otherwise I would really have fallen into your trap."
Lu Xingzhou's face was ugly and he didn't have time to think too much. Seeing the incoming fire dragon approaching with the burning heat wave, he condensed the claws of his right hand to catch the golden fire dragon.
"Boom!"
The claw shadow and the fire dragon collided with each other, and a huge heat wave exploded instantly.
The violent spiritual impact knocked Lu Xingzhou's whole body flying out and hit the rock wall hard.
